exactCurrentOperatorFacts: The streak counter is saved separately by line-bet value.
Ten qualifying winning results trigger Jackpot Lucky.
A non-winning result after four through nine consecutive winning results triggers the corresponding Lucky Free Spins award; state nine corresponds to 60 free games.
Winning results obtained during Bonus Dice also count toward streak awards and the jackpot.
correction: Because Bonus Dice winning results count toward the streak, the previously convenient binary simplification 'next paid spin wins -> jackpot, next paid spin loses -> 60 free games' is not accepted as an execution model until the exact sequencing of a state-9 paid spin that also activates Bonus Dice is established from same-title rules/runtime evidence.
softwareEffect: streak-of-luck-state9-one-spin-screen-v1.mjs v1.1 returns BLOCKED_BONUS_DICE_SEQUENCE_UNRESOLVED unless bonusDiceSequencingResolved=true. The formula remains available only as a sensitivity calculation.
supersedesWithinBenchmark: Any Streak state-9 language in autonomous-practice-benchmark-2026-08-29-v1 that describes the next paid spin as an unconditional two-branch terminal event must be read subject to this correction.
